blurb: Durango Hills Golf Club is a desert-style golf course featuring four par four holes and fourteen par three holes. The course offers undulating greens and scenic views of Red Rock, Snow, and Sheep mountain ranges. The club includes a full service golf shop and the Durango Grill restaurant and bar serving breakfast and lunch daily.
